integrity: The Picard-index formula is proved from local class groups and the extrema are proved by exact inequalities; finite Reid--Tai and lcm enumeration is used only as a regression check.
scientific_limitations: Specialized to ordinary weighted projective spaces P(1^r,a,b) over C; it does not optimize Picard index for arbitrary weighted or fake weighted projective spaces, and originality is supported by documented searches rather than an exhaustive literature proof.
title: Sharp Picard-index bounds in the two-heavy weighted-projective family
